families.name: Flat vector and geometric animation
families.strength: Shapes, paths and transformations make a relationship visible.

families.name: Illustrated and cel character performance
families.strength: Acting and reactions carry meaning beyond labels.

families.name: Pixel and retro-computing language
families.strength: Discrete objects, sprites and deliberate resolution become a visual language.

families.name: Paper, cutout and collage
families.strength: Layering, rearranging, revealing and folding material express the idea.

families.name: Painterly, ink and drawn media
families.strength: Strokes, washes and evolving drawings make the image.

families.name: Clay and stop-motion-inspired materials
families.strength: Tactile objects have weight, deformation and deliberate poses.

families.name: Isometric and miniature systems
families.strength: Spatial construction and routes explain a system.

families.name: Dimensional product animation
families.strength: Actual geometry and materials reveal physical construction.

families.name: Diagrammatic and evidence-driven animation
families.strength: Quantities and relationships determine the picture.

families.name: Real footage with integrated graphics
families.strength: Real actions are clarified by anchored annotations and edits.

families.name: Expressive typography
families.strength: Language itself carries the visual idea.

families.name: Abstract and procedural graphics
families.strength: A pattern or field expresses an approved identity or thematic idea.
